name: The New Universes ~ Eine Neue Reise Beginnt ~ Chapter 1
source: In the distant future where Humanity has expanded far beyond Earth into a war-torn, conflict filled galaxy a young woman struggles through her life and adventures gaining friends, learning about herself and working to save her galaxy. The New Universes Project's Eine Neue Reise Beginnt First Chapter follows Sumire Rembrant an estranged princess whom moves to an academy in space in an effort to help her sister and learn more about herself. As she moves through her adventures Sumire encounters her past, finds love and builds a new future for herself. This story is the adaptation of the first set of The new Universes Project Eine Neue Reise Beginnt stories.
translation: 在遥远的未来，人类的足迹早已远远超出地球，踏入一个饱受战火与冲突摧残的银河系。一名年轻女子在生活与冒险中艰难前行，结识朋友、认识自己，并努力拯救银河系。《The New Universes Project》旗下《Eine Neue Reise Beginnt》的第一章，讲述疏离于王室的公主苏米蕾·伦布兰特的故事。为了帮助姐妹并进一步了解自己，她来到一所太空学院。随着冒险展开，苏米蕾面对自己的过去，找到爱情，并为自己开创新的未来。本作改编自《The New Universes Project》旗下《Eine Neue Reise Beginnt》的第一组故事。
